verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page has a single first-party line saying workflows can be automated with schedules or webhooks. Webhook triggers loosely fit event-driven automation; schedules are recurring time-based runs, not event rules. There is no documentation of how rules are defined, which events exist, or what actions can be triggered. Missing for 10: documented rule/trigger definition, a catalog of supported events and actions, conditions and logic, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
